deps.edn.reason: The git floors and pins on repositories that are bundled here become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. The other sections are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (alias :test reduced to :extra-paths, alias :lint): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package.

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the paths.

test/cssom/core_test.cljk.reason: The suite opens fixture files by a path relative to the old repository root (test/...). The library suites run from the root of this repository, so each such path names the file where it now lives (lib/kotoba.cssom/test/...). Nothing else in the file changes.

src/cssom/margin_collapse.kotoba.reason: Native f64 incremental implementation of the existing CSSOM adjoining-margin extrema rule.

test/native/margin_collapse.kotoba.reason: Native fractional and mixed-sign margin collapse and non-finite rejection fixture.

src/cssom/block_width.kotoba.reason: Native f64 CSS normal-flow non-replaced block horizontal constraint solver for already resolved values.

test/native/block_width.kotoba.reason: Native block width, box sizing, auto margins, direction and invalid-input fixtures.
